scope: Independent Python RFB 3.8 client and actual Tk/X11 STRING selection; no Rust client code; synthetic clipboard text only.

configuration.network: container loopback only; no host port mapping

observations.variant: default startup, client clipboard sent before selection window exists
same isolated server startup with X11VNC_AVOID_WINDOWS=never
default startup, keep same RFB connection until created selwin log

source_evidence.finding: guess_dm_gone waits 45 seconds after last_client without a window manager; no clients means not ready.
initialize_xevents creates selwin only when guess_dm_gone(8,45) succeeds.
xcut_receive claims CLIPBOARD only when selwin exists; recording text before that does not establish X11 ownership.
sel_waittime defaults to 15 seconds, independently delaying initial server selection transmission.

conclusion: The reproduced traditional Latin-1 failure is caused by the headless x11vnc selection-owner initialization window. Waiting for explicit selection readiness makes both directions pass without changing client code. This does not establish Extended Clipboard/Unicode/empty-text support or acceptance of the Rust integration test.
cleanup: All diagnostic-owned Xvfb, x11vnc and Tk helper processes terminated; existing containers and matrix servers were not restarted.
